WORKFLOW:
PATTERN: Run Whisnap tests programmatically via:
`xcodebuild test -scheme Whisnap -destination 'id=<SIMULATOR_UDID>' -parallel-testing-enabled NO 2>&1 | tail -100`
WHEN: Want to see all test failures at once without using Xcode UI, or running from CLI
WHY: The original 'never use xcodebuild test' rule was about parallel testing spawning simulator clones — disabling parallelism + pinning to a specific already-booted simulator UDID avoids the clone problem entirely
GOTCHA: Must use a specific simulator UDID (not just 'iPhone 17 Pro' name) and simulator must already be booted — get UDID via `xcrun simctl list devices booted`
